question: Does RoBERTa outperform BERT?
title: Resolving the Scope of Speculation and Negation using Transformer-Based Architectures
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents indicate that XLNet consistently outperforms both BERT and RoBERTa in the tasks of speculation cue detection and scope resolution, contrary to results on other benchmark datasets. This is explicitly stated in Text 2 and Text 5, which report that XLNet outperforms RoBERTa in these specific tasks.
